title: Case REQ-20261113-LIF005 — death notification
content:
Death notification emailed to Amelia, Senior Risk Adviser, by Robert Chen on Fri 13 Nov 2026 and captured by the Onboarding Agent for Olivia (Onboarding & Requests). Case REQ-20261113-LIF005 · request type Death claim · existing clients.

From: Robert Chen (robert.chen@example.com, 0491 570 313), client number CL-101935.
Message (summary): Robert lets Amelia know that his wife Mei died suddenly on Monday 12 October 2026 and asks what he needs to do about Mei's insurance. He attached a certified copy of Mei's death certificate and a certified copy of his own ID.

Mei Chen (DOB 05/06/1984), pharmacist, client number CL-101934, died suddenly of a brain aneurysm on Mon 12 Oct 2026, aged 42. Robert Chen, 44 (DOB 30/01/1982), secondary school teacher, Box Hill VIC. Children Lily (12) and Max (9). Clients of Caldova since 2019.

Cover on file: Corella Life policy CR-19033105 on Mei's life (outside super) — life cover $1,000,000; nominated beneficiary Robert 100% (see 'Case REQ-20261113-LIF005 — policy schedule and nomination').

Priority: High — bereavement. Vulnerable client: a person handles every contact.

In-good-order checklist:
✅ certified copy of the death certificate
✅ certified ID for the claimant, Robert
✅ policy number and nominated beneficiary on file
⚠️ Corella Life claim form to be completed with Robert, with Ben's help
⚠️ bank account in Robert's own name for the payment

Care plan (approved by Theo, Practice Team Leader): one named contact for the family — Amelia; Theo approves every message to the family; gentle, plain language and no chasing.

Routing: Team Leader Office (compassionate oversight) → Financial Crime (document checks) → Claims (policy check, claim pack, approval and lodgement) → Client Communications.
